fullDescription: A professional 1920x1080 fixed-canvas strategic framework designed for high-stakes business presentations and corporate roadmaps. Featuring high-contrast utilitarianism, the style utilizes 'Inter Tight' typography with hierarchy established through font weight rather than size. A minimalist white background is structured by a 2px black grid, using a single high-chroma red (#F40009) for semantic signals and strategic accents. Optimized for executive visibility, it avoids all shadows, gradients, or rounded corners, favoring sharp-edged precision and generous whitespace to convey confidence. Suitable for fintech dashboards, strategic marketing plans, and operational execution frameworks.

structured.summary: A rigid, high-precision strategic execution framework on a fixed 1920x1080 canvas, characterized by a utilitarian 2px black grid, Inter Tight typography, and selective use of semantic red (#F40009) to highlight primary goals and trending data.

style.description: The design centers on 'Utilitarian Precision'. It uses a pure white (#FFFFFF) background with dark zinc (#18181B) borders and text. All corners are 90-degree sharp (0px radius). Typography relies on Inter Tight, ranging from 400 (regular) to 900 (black) weights. A strategic red (#F40009) is used sparingly to denote 'Critical Path' or 'High Importance' items. No shadows, gradients, or soft styling are permitted.
style.prompt: Layout: Fixed 1920x1080 canvas with a 2px solid #18181B border surrounding the entire work area. Typography: Inter Tight for all elements. Headings in 800-900 weight, tracking -0.025em. Labels in 700 weight, 11px size, tracking 0.25em, uppercase. Body text in 500-600 weight. Color Palette: Pure White (#FFFFFF), Deep Black (#18181B), Strategic Red (#F40009), and muted Zinc variations (#71717A, #A1A1AA) for secondary labels. Geometry: 0px border-radius on all components. Spacing: 10-12 unit padding (40-48px) within all major grid cells. Accents: Use #F40009 exclusively for the 'Primary Goal', 'Trending' statuses, and key thesis keywords. No animations beyond instant state changes if interactive.

layout_and_structure.description: The framework is divided into three primary horizontal tiers: a thesis header, a core strategy grid with split columns, and an execution trinity for tactical outputs.

prompts.prompt: The entire view is a fixed 1920x1080px box. All internal sections are divided by 2px solid #18181B borders. Use a box-sizing: border-box model to ensure the grid remains perfectly aligned within the viewport.

Height: 140px. Divided into left-aligned metadata (Brand/Quarter/Framework name) and a right-aligned section for high-level thesis statements. The right side features two distinct blocks: 'Primary Goal' and 'Success Lens', with the most critical words highlighted in #F40009. Text should be large (3xl or 4xl) and bold.

Height: 520px. Split into a 4-column left area and an 8-column right area. The left column contains the 'Overarching Ambition' (large, commanding text with greyed-out secondary phrases) and 'Target Demographic' (oversized black-weight text). The right column is a 3-column grid for 'Brand Portfolio', where each card features a header, a status tag (Leads, Follows, Punctuate) in a thin border box, and a descriptive paragraph.

The remaining vertical space (~420px) is split into three equal-width columns. Column 1: 'Moment Mapping'—a 4-cell horizontal grid of icons with labels, the last cell being the 'Trending' item with a #F40009 border. Column 2: 'Strategic Assets'—a text-heavy section with a decorative 'infrastructure' footer made of small empty grid boxes. Column 3: 'Key Outputs'—features a primary engine headline in red and a list of secondary assets represented as bordered badges with checkmark icons.

special_ui_components.description: Small, high-precision status indicators found in card headers.
special_ui_components.prompt: A rectangle with a 1px solid #18181B or #D4D4D8 border. Padding: 4px 8px. Text: 10px bold uppercase, tracking 0.1em. Content is center-aligned. Sharp corners.

special_ui_components.description: Equal-sized interactive or static cells for mapping activities.
special_ui_components.prompt: Square-ish cells with a 1px solid #D4D4D8 border. Center-aligned content featuring a 3xl size icon followed by an 11px bold uppercase label. The 'active' or 'trending' cell uses a 2px #F40009 border and matching red icon/text.
Height 40px. Border: 1px solid #D4D4D8. Padding: 0 16px. Text: 11px bold uppercase. Prefixed with a small checkmark icon (16px size) in a muted zinc color.

structured.special_notes: Must strictly adhere to 0px border-radius. Every border must be #18181B or #D4D4D8. Red (#F40009) must never be used for backgrounds, only for text highlights and primary status borders. Ensure all uppercase labels have a tracking of 0.25em for readability.
